status_summary: An Attorney General memorandum of 2025-02-05 directed prosecutors to charge the most serious readily provable offense, defined as those carrying the most significant mandatory minimums, and named the ACCA as an example. S. 2250 and its House companion H.R. 4334, each titled the Restoring the Armed Career Criminal Act, were introduced on 2025-07-10 and referred to the Judiciary Committees. The Senate bill would replace 18 U.S.C. 924(e) with a 15-to-30-year mandatory sentence based on three prior serious felony convictions. The GovInfo bill status records for both bills (last updated 2026-08-10 and 2026-04-28) list only introduction and referral on 2025-07-10, with no hearing, markup or report; the Senate bill has one cosponsor and the House bill none listed.
